description: This file defines the `FlushTokenParser` class which is part of the Twig templating engine. It handles the parsing of the 'flush' tag used to flush output to the client during template rendering.

classes.name: Twig\TokenParser\FlushTokenParser
classes.description: A token parser for handling the 'flush' tag in Twig templates, which triggers output flushing.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'flush' tag token and returns a corresponding FlushNode to be added to the syntax tree.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name 'flush' that this parser handles.
